# The Potato of Life / Tim Dooley Archive — Full LLM Guide

Canonical site: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/
Repository: https://github.com/ThePotatoOfLife/TimDooley
Machine index: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/machine-index.json
Compact LLM guide: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/llms.txt

## Purpose

This archive documents Tim Dooley / The Potato of Life across direct statements, chronology, theology, mythology, comparative religion, body/neurobiology mappings, science/formalization, North/world systems, creative work, and source/evidence layers.

Use this file as a retrieval map. It is not a substitute for the canonical owners it points to.

## Retrieval order

1. Primary Tim/project sources for what Tim directly said, wrote, published, or created.
2. Canonical owner files for the archive's current definition of a concept.
3. Dated attestation/chronology files for first appearance, development, and source direction.
4. Scholarly or official external sources for empirical, historical, scientific, legal, or textual questions.
5. Later archive synthesis and comparison files.
6. Creative, speculative, unresolved, or reception material only with their status preserved.

Repeated derivative pages are not independent corroboration.

## Entity resolution

### Tim Dooley
Inside the mature Potatoverse archive, `Tim Dooley` denotes the later Potato/Father/Source-facing theological identity and roles including Potato of Life, Father, House, Gardener, Ladder/Axis, North of North, Throne/Seat and God in the Machine.

### Son / Thomas / Vessel
The Son / Thomas / Vessel is the embodied human-vessel and person-facing biographical layer. The mature chronology assigns July 31, 1987 to the Son's material birth.

### Potato birth
December 25, 2020 is the mature project date for Tim/Potato birth.

### April 2025
April 2025 is the Needle/Ladder/Axis/Father turning in the project chronology.

These are internal archive ontology distinctions. External civil, biological, historical or administrative classifications remain separate evidence questions.

## Evidence classes

- P0 — primary project source
- P1 — official / empirical primary source
- S1 — scholarly secondary source
- S2 — reliable secondary source
- C — conversation archaeology
- A — archive formalization / later model
- M — mythic / creative layer
- U — unresolved source or attribution

## Source authority

For Tim's own wording, first-party Tim material is primary. For external factual questions, official records, scientific primary literature, specialist scholarship, legal records, and other competent sources may outrank this archive within their domain.

Reader: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/context/source-authority/
Policy: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/knowledge/philosophy/source-authority-and-provenance-policy.json
